//: Pack contributions to harness-core sockets (TN-26-005). The core owns the mechanisms; this file owns the TypeScript pack's content. specTechNouns feeds the phase gate's Intake check (ADR 2026-032): non-blessed API frameworks and schema engines that must not survive intake into a spec body. contractFileSuffixes feeds the core's ticket-design, path-gate and phase-gate contract recognition (ADR 2026-052): the filename suffix that marks a design contract in a project composing this pack.
//projectSetup: Project dependency setup sockets (ADR 2026-051). projectSetupCommands are argv lists the host entry runs in order, without a shell, in the project root; each must install only from a committed lockfile and never run the project package's own lifecycle scripts: no role may write package.json (ADR 2026-054), and refusing its scripts keeps that true even for a hand edit the drift check has not yet seen. projectSetupProbes are project-relative paths that exist only after those commands succeed. projectIgnoreRules are .gitignore lines for what setup and builds produce.
//projectManifest: projectManifestScripts are pack-relative scripts the project initializer runs (node, project dir and harness source root as argv) after it writes its own files (ADR 2026-051): this pack writes the project's package manifest and lockfile. The script reads projectPackageTemplate (exactly one across the composition), and every composed pack's projectScripts and pins.
//projectConfig: Project configuration is generated, never written by a role (ADR 2026-054). pins, projectScripts and projectCheckScripts feed scripts/project-package.ts: ts-morph is pinned because the delivered surface check needs it, and check:surface is folded into the generated check so delivery finds the manifest already wired. projectCheckScripts are script names folded into `check` in composition order. projectShippedFiles (project path → pack-relative source) are copied verbatim at init, so the surface checker check:surface runs exists from the start; delivery finds it already shipped. projectNestedConfigNames are file-name globs that count as config at any depth: Node and the test runner's transform read the nearest package.json and tsconfig for each file, so a nested one no pack generates is drift, and the path policy refuses every role a write to one. projectDependencyDirs are the directory names installed dependencies resolve from: skipped by the drift walk only at the root; a nested one anywhere is drift and write-denied for every role, because Node, the type-checker and the bundler resolve it before the root's. projectConfigNames are root file-name globs that count as project config for this stack: scripts/project-config.ts refuses at the phase gates when any of them differs from, or is missing from, or is not produced by, what the composed packs generate; `bounded sync-config` (the user's command) rewrites them.
